## Generated resource handles

[Resource handles](resources.md) cover instances, profiles, sessions, turns and the native gateway entry point. They are generated from the pinned contracts. Their presence in the SDK is not a runtime capability check.

For individual generated request and response models, consult [the generated type modules](https://github.com/AnasMaar/edith-hermes-sdk/tree/main/src/edith_hermes/generated). Transport schemas and upstream source hashes live in [contracts](https://github.com/AnasMaar/edith-hermes-sdk/tree/main/contracts).
